## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `CsvFaultTolerance`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `csv-fault-tolerance`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **CsvFaultTolerance**.

## Step 2: Configuration

1. <!-- manual: Open the listener by clicking its name under Listeners in the sidebar, or under Attached Listeners in the FTP Integration Configuration panel. -->
2. <!-- manual: Scroll to the Csv Fail Safe field and click Record to open the builder. -->
3. <!-- manual: In the Record Configuration panel, tick the top-level FailSafeOptions checkbox to include the record, tick contentType, and pick an enum value: -->
4. <!-- manual: Close the panel and click Save. Every CSV handler on every service attached to this listener now skips malformed rows. -->
